role: Transparency by sampling a render of the scene behind the mesh at the pixel's screen position (FBO).
adaptation: The FBO becomes a user-supplied Refraction TOP sampled at gl_FragCoord * uTDGeneral.viewport.zw. TouchDesigner renders it in a separate Render TOP that excludes the glass; no in-material hide/show trick.

role: refract() of the eye vector by the surface normal, used as a screen offset.
adaptation: The bend is converted to a projected, aspect-correct screen offset: (refract - eye) in camera space times Thickness, scaled by the camera's own projection and depth. Heckel adds refractVec.xy straight to the screen coordinates without projecting it through the camera (his scenes can be orbited), so the shift does not follow camera distance, lens or orientation.

role: Chromatic dispersion with per-channel IORs and extra samples per loop to smooth it.
adaptation: Replaced the R/G/B (and later 6-band) loop by a loop over spectrum samples: each sample has its own IOR and a smooth R/G/B weight, normalised per channel. One texture read per sample instead of six. The same samples double as the frost blur (a disc placed by the R2 quasirandom sequence), with mipmap levels to keep the blur continuous.

role: Saturation by mixing with luminance (weights 0.2125, 0.7154, 0.0721).
adaptation: Used as saturateColour(), applied once after the loop instead of inside it.

role: RGB to rygcbv split for finer dispersion control.
adaptation: Not ported. The spectrum weights achieve a smooth multi-band split without per-band IOR controls.

role: Blinn-Phong specular with the squared N.H term, plus diffuse.
adaptation: Kept the squared N.H term; the half vector uses the direction toward the camera (Heckel's code adds the camera-to-surface vector). Light colour and direction are parameters.

role: Fresnel factor pow(1 - |N.V|, power) added as a glow.
adaptation: Used twice: as the rim glow (Rim colour x Rim amount) and to weight the reflection between the IOR's base reflectance and 1. Mirror pushes that weight to 1.

role: Backside rendering: render back faces first, then front faces refracting that result.
adaptation: Optional render_back Render TOP with a second GLSL MAT (front faces culled, blending off). Its alpha stores the back surface's distance, so the front pass also measures true thickness for absorption and the bend.

role: Archived final scene: the exact shaders behind the article (16 samples, 6 IORs, saturation, specular, fresnel).
adaptation: Read for the actual loop structure and constants; no lines copied verbatim. All GLSL in this study is newly written for TouchDesigner's GLSL MAT.

role: Official TouchDesigner GLSL MAT API (read 2026-11-01, page oldid 38399).
adaptation: TDPos/TDNormal/TDDeform/TDDeformNorm/TDWorldToProj; TDCameraIndex is vertex-only so it is passed as a flat varying; uTDMats members, uTDGeneral.viewport, TDFrontFacing, TDCheckDiscard, TDOutputSwizzle.
